data.one_liner: Pure Dart client for the Anthropic API to access Claude models.
data.what_it_does: Provides type-safe access to Anthropic's Claude models with support for messages, streaming, tool use, extended thinking, multimodal inputs, files, and batch processing. Runs across mobile, desktop, web, and server-side Dart.
use_when: You need to integrate Claude models into a Dart or Flutter application
You require type-safe access to Anthropic API features like tool calling, streaming, and vision
avoid_when: You are using a different AI provider like Google Gemini or OpenAI exclusively
You need an on-device local model instead of a cloud-hosted API
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Anthropic API features including messages, streaming, and tools
weaknesses: Requires an external API key and internet connection to Anthropic's servers
Not suitable for offline on-device inference
data.setup_notes: Requires setting the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable or configuring an ApiKeyProvider.

alternatives.name: firebase_ai
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you want to use Google's Gemini models via Firebase instead of Anthropic.

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you want to run local Llama models rather than using a hosted cloud API.
